diagnosis.failure_mode: The policy network receives zero or near-zero gradients during training. Evidence: (1) Policy loss is essentially zero (values ~1e-7 to 1e-8), (2) Clipfrac is always 0.0 meaning the PPO clip never activates, (3) Approx KL is always exactly 0.0 indicating no policy divergence from the initial policy, (4) Policy entropy stays constant at ln(2) indicating no learning. The policy parameters are likely frozen or the loss computation is broken (e.g., detached from computational graph, zero advantage estimates, or incorrect loss formula). This prevents any meaningful behavior learning, resulting in flat episodic returns.
